page.overview:
What is Cabralin?

Cabralin is a peaceful plane with, according to Roreca, "lots of rolling hills and fields". One known location on Cabralin is the white-aligned Cabralin Shire.

It was conquered and compleated by New Phyrexia's Machine Legion after the plane was broken through by Realmbreaker.
